newsitem.title: USA: Failure Group foresees Jan 3 Q4 shr loss.
newsitem.headline: Failure Group foresees Jan 3 Q4 shr loss.

text.p: Failure Group Inc said Friday that preliminary financial results of its fourth quarter, ended January 3, made it expect a loss of between $0.29a share and $0.31 a share for the period.
The group, which comprises four operating subsidiaries including Failure Analysis Associates, said the loss would compare with a profit of $0.04 a share for the same period last year.
It said it blamed the latest quarter's loss on a write-off and a restructuring charge.
It said it took a write-off of $0.14 a share in the fourth quarter for the remaining goodwill balance associated with the May 1993 acquisition of PLG Inc, a reliability and risk assessment unit.
The group also said it took a $0.02 a share charge for the restructuring of PLG.
